QuestInfo.name: Newbie's Gift
QuestInfo.0: The Maple Administrator has something to say to you.
QuestInfo.1: You have received a gift from the Administrator.
QuestInfo.2: You received a gift from the Administrator. Work on leveling up to receive another gift at level 30.

0.0: Hello, #h0#! Welcome to Maple World! We're in the midst of a fabulous event to welcome all our new Maplers! Would you like to receive your gift now?

yes.0: Open your Inventory and double-click on your gift! It's full of wonderful items to make you look your best! Oh, and there's more! When you reach Lv. 30, there are more gifts waiting for you! See you then!

no.0: Oh, you don't want a gift? Okay. Talk to me if you change your mind.
